test_modes.name: Internal Loop Back Mode
test_modes.purpose: Hot self-test of the M_CAN protocol stack without disturbing the connected CAN bus. m_can_rx is disconnected internally; m_can_tx is held recessive; transmitted bits are looped back to the receiver path.

test_modes.name: External Loop Back Mode
test_modes.purpose: Hardware self-test with bus participation; transmitted bits are visible at m_can_tx and looped back to the receiver. The M_CAN ignores acknowledge errors so the test is independent of external stimulation.

test_modes.name: Bus Monitoring Mode (silent listening)
test_modes.purpose: Receive valid data + remote frames; cannot transmit dominant bits — dominant ACK / error flags are rerouted internally so the bus is not disturbed; TXBRP held in reset. Used for bus traffic analysis.

test_modes.name: Tx Pin Driver Control
test_modes.purpose: TEST.TX = 00 normal; 01 Sample-Point monitoring at m_can_tx; 10 force dominant on m_can_tx; 11 force recessive on m_can_tx (production tests / DC checks).

test_modes.name: Rx Pin Monitor
test_modes.purpose: TEST.RX reflects the current m_can_rx pin value (0 = dominant, 1 = recessive); allows the CPU to verify PHY-side bus state.

test_modes.name: Restricted Operation Mode (NOT a test mode but a constrained ops mode)
test_modes.purpose: Receives data + remote frames + sends ACK; does NOT send error/data/remote/overload frames. Used for bit-rate detection on unknown CAN networks; freezes TEC + REC (CEL keeps counting).

spec_provided_observability.name: ECR.CEL[7:0]
spec_provided_observability.purpose: CAN Error Logging — 8-bit counter incrementing once per CAN protocol error that incremented TEC/REC; overflows → IR.ELO. Cleared on read of byte 2.

spec_provided_observability.name: ECR.TEC[7:0]
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Transmit Error Counter (0..255). Frozen in Restricted Operation Mode.

spec_provided_observability.name: ECR.REC[6:0] / ECR.RP
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Receive Error Counter (0..127) + Receive Error Passive flag (1 when REC ≥ 128).

spec_provided_observability.name: PSR.BO / EW / EP
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Live Bus_Off / Error_Warning / Error_Passive status flags.

spec_provided_observability.name: PSR.ACT[1:0]
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Module activity: 00 sync / 01 idle / 10 receiver / 11 transmitter. Forced to 00 by Protocol Exception.

spec_provided_observability.name: PSR.LEC[2:0] / PSR.DLEC[2:0]
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Last Error Code in arbitration phase (LEC) and data phase (DLEC) — values 0 No / 1 Stuff / 2 Form / 3 Ack / 4 Bit1 / 5 Bit0 / 6 CRC / 7 NoChange.

spec_provided_observability.name: PSR.PXE / RFDF / RBRS / RESI
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Protocol Exception flag + receive-side flags for last CAN FD frame (FDF / BRS / ESI seen).

spec_provided_observability.name: PSR.TDCV[6:0]
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Transmitter Delay Compensation Value — measured SSP position in data phase (0..127 mtq).

spec_provided_observability.name: TEST.RX / TEST.TX / TEST.LBCK
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Direct CAN pin observability + Tx driver control + Loop Back enable.

spec_provided_observability.name: TEST.SVAL/TXBNS / PVAL/TXBNP
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Tx Buffer Number Started (last started) + Tx Buffer Number Prepared (next to send) — visible to host for Tx debug.

spec_provided_observability.name: HPMS
spec_provided_observability.purpose: High Priority Message Status — last priority-filter match snapshot (FLST + FIDX + MSI + BIDX).

spec_provided_observability.name: RXFnS / TXFQS / TXEFS
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Live FIFO put/get/fill levels for the two Rx FIFOs + Tx FIFO/Queue + Tx Event FIFO.

spec_provided_observability.name: NDAT1 / NDAT2
spec_provided_observability.purpose: 64 New-Data flags for dedicated Rx Buffers.

spec_provided_observability.name: RXF1S.DMS[1:0]
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Debug Message State (00 idle / 01 A / 10 A+B / 11 A+B+C) — observes the debug-on-CAN state machine.

spec_provided_observability.name: Extension Interface
spec_provided_observability.purpose: All Interrupt Register flags + selected status/control signals routed to module-external interrupt unit (optional).

interrupt_observability.30_flags_in_IR: ARA / PED / PEA / WDI / BO / EW / EP / ELO / BEU / BEC / DRX / TOO / MRAF / TSW / TEFL / TEFF / TEFW / TEFN / TFE / TCF / TC / HPM / RF1L / RF1F / RF1W / RF1N / RF0L / RF0F / RF0W / RF0N.
interrupt_observability.edge_sensitive: Each flag set when the corresponding condition is detected (edge); remains set until host writes 1 (W1C). Hard reset clears.
interrupt_observability.per_flag_enable_IE: Bit n = 1 enables interrupt source n on the selected line.
interrupt_observability.per_flag_line_select_ILS: Bit n = 0 routes to m_can_int0, 1 to m_can_int1.
interrupt_observability.line_enable_ILE: EINT0 / EINT1 enable / disable the two interrupt outputs to the CPU.

self_check_mechanisms: Monitoring — transmitters compare bit levels driven to bus levels detected (using the Secondary Sample Point in CAN FD data phase when TDC is enabled).
Cyclic Redundancy Check — 15-bit BCH for Classical CAN; 17-bit (≤16 B) or 21-bit (>16 B) for CAN FD; ISO mode adds 4-bit stuff-count + parity protection.
Bit Stuffing — detect 6 consecutive identical bits in stuffed fields = STUFF ERROR.
Message Frame Check — fixed-form fields (CRC DELIMITER, ACK DELIMITER, EOF, INTERMISSION, fixed stuff bits in CAN FD CRC) checked for illegal bits = FORM ERROR.
Protocol Exception detection — receiver sees FDF = recessive AND res = recessive → set PSR.PXE; PSR.ACT → integrating (when CCCR.PXHD = 0).
RAM Watchdog (RWD) — Message RAM access without READY response within RWD.WDC counts → IR.WDI.
External ECC/Parity feedback — m_can_aeim_berr[1:0] inputs trigger IR.BEC (corrected) / IR.BEU (uncorrected, sets CCCR.INIT to prevent transmitting corrupted data).

error_count_thresholds.consequence: Node enters error-passive state — PSR.EP = 1 + IR.EP change. In CAN FD transmitted ESI bit forced recessive.
TX error count ≥ 256 → node enters bus-off state — PSR.BO = 1 + IR.BO change + CCCR.INIT set internally.

recovery_from_bus_off: After 129 occurrences of Bus_Idle (129 × 11 consecutive recessive bits) following CPU clearing CCCR.INIT, the M_CAN may rejoin as error-active (both counters reset to 0). PSR.LEC is updated to Bit0Error each time an 11-recessive-bit sequence is monitored, so the CPU can poll PSR.LEC to track recovery progress. ECR.REC counts these 11-recessive sequences.

debug_on_can_support.method: Three consecutive Rx Buffers used to store Debug Messages A / B / C; filter elements with SFEC/EFEC = 111 + SFID2/EFID2[10:9] coded 01 (A), 10 (B), 11 (C). RXF1S.DMS reflects the state machine.
debug_on_can_support.dma_handoff: After A+B+C stored in order, m_can_dma_req asserts; DMA controller reads the three messages then asserts m_can_dma_ack which resets m_can_dma_req. M_CAN is then ready for the next debug-message triple.
debug_on_can_support.state_machine: DMS = 00 (idle / reset) → DMS = 01 (msg A received) → DMS = 10 (A+B received) → DMS = 11 (A+B+C received → DMA req) → DMS = 00 (after DMA ack). Out-of-order receptions restart the sequence.

notes: Beyond protocol-level self-checking the M_CAN provides a rich on-chip debug surface: Test Register (CAN pin control / monitor), Loop Back modes, Bus Monitoring Mode, Restricted Operation Mode, Tx FIFO/Queue/Event status, per-buffer Tx state, Acceptance Filter index visibility (HPMS / FIDX in Rx element), and 30 interrupt flags. Scan / JTAG / BIST insertion is left to the integrator (M_CAN is delivered as VHDL synthesis-ready RTL).
